description: (1) Construction of a single storey side extension, (2) enlargement of existing window opening to facilitate the installation of a door within western elevation, (3) installation of three roof-lights, (4) alterations to eastern elevation fenestration to facilitate the installation of aluminium windows.
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: To comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and supporting documents and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing number (add reference number)dated (date on the plans) - documents entitled (document title) dated (date on the document)

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

No above-ground construction shall take place until a detailed schedule of all proposed external materials and finishes, accompanied by annotated elevation drawings has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.The submission shall include:a) The manufacturer, product name and reference, colour, texture and finish of each material, including RAL colour references where applicable;b) Details of brickwork, mortar colour and joint profile, brick bond, roofing materials, fascias, soffits, rainwater goods, windows, doors and rooflights;c) Annotated elevations identifying the precise location and extent of each material, cross-referenced to the materials schedule and board; andThe development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To secure a satisfactory appearance and preserve the character and appearance of the Walthamstow Village Conservation Area, in accordance with Policies 53, 70 and 72 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).

No development, including demolition, site clearance or groundworks, shall commence until a detailed Arboricultural Method Statement and final Tree Protection Plan have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.The submitted details shall include:a) Protective fencing and ground protection for retained trees on and adjoining the site;b) Foundation design, excavation methods and any necessary root barriers;c) The routing and installation methods for underground services;d) Construction details for the ramped access, hard surfacing and final landscaping within root protection areas;e) Locations for site compounds, material storage and construction access; andf) The sequence of works and arrangements for arboricultural supervision and monitoring.The approved protection measures shall be installed before development commences and retained for the duration of construction, except where otherwise specified in the approved Method Statement. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To safeguard retained trees and their contribution to local amenity, biodiversity and the character and appearance of the Walthamstow Village Conservation Area, in accordance with Policies 72, 79 and 80 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).
